title: September 8–10 2014 Arizona local-time rainfall
method: Each p1h ending timestamp represents preceding one hour; constant hourly mean rate equals depth/1h. No overlapping accumulation sum. Index255 stays null.
domain: Regional Trico/Avra reusable crop, 111.7–110.5 W and 31.7–32.8 N pixel centers; not a full delineated watershed or a SFINCS mesh.
source: Iowa Environmental Mesonet MRMS quantitative PNG archive
license: IEM public-use archive; credit IEM and NOAA; derived radar estimates, not gauge truth

dailyCrossChecks.interpretation: Same endpoint and preceding 24 nonoverlapping hours, common valid cells only. Quantization and product differences mean equality is not assumed; no adjustment applied.
